hunks.baseline: “Oh, come on. What kind of person exposes someone like that? I was just getting to the fun part.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, come on. Who gives the game away like that? I was just getting to the fun part.”

hunks.baseline: Temur and Chinggen realized who the middle-aged man was and opened their eyes wide.
hunks.sol: Temur and Chinggen finally realized who the middle-aged man was, and their eyes went wide.

hunks.baseline: The eyepatched middle-aged man, Black Sand, nodded without hesitation.
hunks.sol: The eyepatched middle-aged man, Black Sand, nodded readily.
Chinggen clicked his tongue in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: Once his surprise had subsided, Temur also looked at Black Sand suspiciously.
hunks.sol: Once his surprise had subsided, Temur, too, directed a look of doubt at Black Sand.

hunks.baseline: After joking around, Black Sand continued.
hunks.sol: As shameless as ever, Black Sand went on.

hunks.baseline: The very word made their blood boil. It was even more powerful to two young and strong chieftains who dreamed of restoring their clans to glory.
hunks.sol: The very word made their blood boil. All the more so for two young, strong chieftains who dreamed of restoring their clan’s former glory.

hunks.baseline: Black Sand pushed a hard, dried lump of horse dung into the fire, which was gradually dying down. The flames suddenly leaped up and flickered in his eyes.
hunks.sol: Black Sand pushed a hardened lump of horse dung into the fire, which was gradually dying down. The flames suddenly leaped up and flickered in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: Attacking a merchant caravan made them mounted bandits, but invading a city and plundering civilians would make them rebels.
hunks.sol: Raiding a merchant caravan made them mounted bandits; invading a city and plundering its civilians made them rebels.

hunks.baseline: “Pung Yang had nearly four hundred subordinates. Less than one in ten of them made it back alive.”
hunks.sol: “Pung Yang had four hundred subordinates. Less than one in ten of them made it back alive.”

hunks.baseline: “The Han Chinese bastard has a big mouth. You think you can do it?”
hunks.sol: “The Han Chinese bastard is all talk. You think you can do it?”

hunks.baseline: “If we finish the job like a bolt of lightning before anyone can react, what could they do?”
hunks.sol: “We just have to strike like a bolt of lightning—too fast for anyone to react.”

hunks.baseline: Chinggen’s throat went dry. The forces under the people gathered here alone totaled three hundred without difficulty.
hunks.sol: Chinggen’s throat went dry. The forces commanded by the men in this room alone came to three hundred, easily.

hunks.baseline: According to the Human Butcher, who had personally met the dead Pung Yang, no one here had inferior martial arts to him.
hunks.sol: According to the Human Butcher, who had personally met the dead Pung Yang, not one of them ranked below him in martial skill.

hunks.baseline: Pung Yang had even defeated the Tiger of Mount Heng, a veteran of the martial world. As a result, rumors had spread that the mounted bandits of the northern plateau were stronger than most First Rate martial artists.
hunks.sol: Pung Yang had even defeated the Tiger of Mount Heng, known as an old hand of the martial world. As a result, rumors had spread that the mounted bandits of the northern plateau were stronger than most First Rate martial artists.
